page_title: COM 2-0 LEC | Como v Lecce 30/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Marco Piccinini is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' The ball goes out for a corner. Lecce can continue in their attacking effort.

90+2' Andrea Belotti (Como) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Marco Piccinini with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+2' It's time for a substitution. Matthias Braunoder (Como) comes on in place of Gabriel Strefezza.
90+2' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
90+1' Ante Rebic (Lecce) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Let's have a look at the offside statistics – 5:0.
90' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

89' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lecce are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
87' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Lecce was in an offside position.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicola Sansone (Lecce) replaces Lassana Coulibaly.
84' It is time for a substitution. Kevin Bonifazi (Lecce) is on for Santiago Pierotti.
83' Substitution. Simone Verdi (Como) replaces Nico Paz.
83' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Yannik Engelhardt will be replaced by Ben Lhassine Kone (Como).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Belotti (Como) comes onto the pitch for Patrick Cutrone.
79' 2 - 0 Patrick Cutrone (Como) gets to the rebound and doesn't hesitate to blast the ball into to the bottom left corner.
76' What was Yannik Engelhardt (Como) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
76' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) blows a good chance to score. He collects a pass inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the goal is brilliantly blocked. Great defending!
75' A pass by Remi Oudin (Lecce) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

74' Lecce players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball has crossed the sideline. Como are taking a throw-in.
73' Remi Oudin (Lecce) delivers a long cross in an attempt to surprise the opponent's sleepy defence.
72' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) passes the ball and slows down the tempo so his team can continue with their combination play.
71' Marco Piccinini interrupts the game. One of the players from Lecce won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
71' Ante Rebic (Lecce) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
70' Como are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
67' Alberto Moreno goes off the pitch and Alberto Dossena (Como) comes on.
66' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) has tested the patience of referee Marco Piccinini and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
66' A player from Como brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
65' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) trips an opposition player and Marco Piccinini signals a foul.
64' Como enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
63' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
62' Corner kick. Como will have an opportunity.
62' Alieu Fadera (Como) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort high over the bar.
60' Here is a change. Antonino Gallo is going off and Marco Giampaolo gives the last tactical orders to Remi Oudin (Lecce).
60' Substitution. Ante Rebic (Lecce) has come on for Nikola Krstovic.
56' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) for his blatant foul.
56' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Como due to an offside in the build-up play.
56' The Como players joy may have been justified, because referee Marco Piccinini is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
54' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Patrick Cutrone (Como) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
54' Patrick Cutrone (Como) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
53' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Como.
52' Alieu Fadera (Como) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
51' Lecce play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.

49' 1 - 0 Patrick Cutrone looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Nico Paz (Como), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner and it ricochets in off the post. The score is 1:0.

47' A clever short pass gives Patrick Cutrone (Como) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) comes off for Mohamed Kaba.
46' Referee Marco Piccinini blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Como.
45+2' Nico Paz (Como) hammers the ball towards the top left corner, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Wladimiro Falcone, who denies him with a terrific save.
45+1' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle and signals a foul after Hamza Rafia (Lecce) brought his opponent down. Como win a free kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for an infringement.
44' Alieu Fadera (Como) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
43' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
42' One of the Como players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
41' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
40' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) will take a corner kick.
38' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' Marco Piccinini interrupts the game. One of the players from Como won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.

37' Nico Paz (Como) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the middle of the goal. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Wladimiro Falcone does well to punch it away.
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Como, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' A player from Lecce takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Nikola Krstovic darts into free space to control the ball.
34' The Como players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
32' A cross by Gabriel Strefezza (Como) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
31' Nico Paz (Como) was unsuccessful with his poor penalty attempt.
30' Como are about to take a corner kick.
30' Nico Paz (Como) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
29' A player from Lecce pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Como.
26' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wladimiro Falcone, who smothers the ball.
24' A pass by Alieu Fadera (Como) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
24' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Piccinini had an easy-decision to make.
24' Como are ruled offside.
23' The free kick from long range, taken by Como, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
22' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Como.
21' Patrick Cutrone (Como) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
21' 62:38 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
20' Good movement by Alieu Fadera (Como), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
20' Lecce exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
17' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
15' Neat passing move from Como in order to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Tete Morente (Lecce) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
13' Tete Morente (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
11' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Piccinini no option but to blow his whistle.
9' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Pepe Reina intercepts the ball.
9' Patrick Cutrone (Como) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Nico Paz was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball.

8' The Lecce players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lecce.

7' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marco Piccinini blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
6' Crossbar! Patrick Cutrone (Como) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
4' A player from Como commits a rough challenge. Marco Piccinini blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
3' Great teamplay by Como as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
1' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Pepe Reina was alert and made a comfortable save.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Lecce will take the kick-off.
Marco Piccinini got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
